 Nov 06, 2026
 By Greg Soulje
 Brownfield Ag Weather Today
 Read 
 Lingering rainfall associated with a departing storm system and its attendant cold front will be mostly limited to the Great Lakes region and the Atlantic Coast States—and should largely end on Friday. Subsequently, the weekend will feature dry weather across most of the country, with showers confined to the Pacific Northwest, the southern half of Texas, and portions of the Great Lakes and Northeastern States. By early next week, generally light rain showers will spread eastward from southern Texas to areas along and near the Gulf Coast. Elsewhere, a brief shot of cool air across the Midwest and Northeast will be replaced by mild weather early next week, while significantly above-normal temperatures will return across portions of the Plains.
